title: 第二十三章 烈焰锤第二十四章 东方黎明
content_zh:
在两大阵纹出现时，也察觉到了阵纹的微妙变化，武书心里是感到十分吃惊的。未曾想到，在很久以前的厚土大陆上，竟是有人能够在阵法方面达到如此实力。
两大镇店神兽身上所铭刻的阵纹，产生共鸣后，竟然会出现空间波动。而两道阵纹合起来用，会形成一种空间法阵。空间类的法阵有多么难以掌握，武书是比任何人都清楚的。
法阵成型后，一股让人难以抗拒的压迫感便是迎面而来，一感觉到压迫感，擎天巨象与吞天巨猿便是自主的向法阵深处俯首。这时，只听一个威严的声音传来，“小子，能够身为武氏一族的族人，你应该感到荣幸。小象、小猿，接下来，这小子的事情就交给我来处理。”
听到说话的声音时，擎天巨象原本有些愉悦的心情，突然就不好了。刚刚所感受到的压迫感，难道只是源自沉睡的大人身上吗？这声音的来源是谁，擎天巨象是十分熟悉的，正是那位大人的兵器烈焰锤的器灵烈焰。
作为器灵烈焰向来自命不凡，毕竟自跟随那位大人以来，那位大人所铸造的绝世兵器，没有一件不是出自它的锤头下。而又因为，烈焰锤自带灵性，但凡经过烈焰锤锤炼的兵器，不仅会自带火焰属性，而且更加适合木属性、火属性的灵体与之融合。
也正是如此，烈焰锤器灵烈焰在那些想要借助器灵之力来提高自己的修行上限的灵物灵兽面前，简直就是如同再生父母。
当然，虽说烈焰锤器灵烈焰的确有自傲的资本，但碑灵却是并不将它放在眼里。就算擎天巨象、吞天巨猿不会正面质问烈焰锤器灵，碑灵却是以一副调皮的语气道，“哟？好久不见，小烈焰。”
小烈焰？？？
在听到有人这么称呼自己时，烈焰锤器灵烈焰是微怒的。而又想到是碑灵这个老妖怪这么称呼自己，器灵烈焰不由无奈道，“碑灵，好久不见。”
碑灵一副套近乎的心机道，“说话，不要这么拘谨嘛？现在我们都是自己人，我已经认主了。”
武书是来自武家，碑灵又是随武书前来战神殿，现在又公然承认认主，这事再明白不过了，表明与武书的关系，就意味着，现在碑灵有保护武书周全的必要。
也是没等烈焰锤器灵烈焰回话，碑灵就是沉声道，“你口中的小子，就是我的主人。”
“哦！”
即便听出来，碑灵是在向自己施加压力，烈焰依旧只是这么简单的应声。
会被如此轻视，碑灵是极其不爽的，碑灵又是沉声道，“他苏醒了？告诉他，若是……”
在碑灵准备放出狠话时，一旁重伤的武书是完全听不下去了。碑灵会有此表现，是想陪着武书前去疗伤，却也是因为烈焰先前对武书所表现出的不敬。在武书看来，将伤养好了，今后有的是机会向烈焰讨教。
也是看出武书伤势很重，烈焰是不置可否道，“神碑，你话太多了，要是有什么话想要和大人说，相信在不久的将来，你有的是机会。”
而烈焰锤器灵烈焰所言，已经非常明确，此次不会让碑灵进入那位大人的安息之地，在碑灵又要开口说话时，武书便是出言阻止道，“小灵你留下来帮助擎天巨象、吞天巨猿。此行，就让夜行兽随我前去吧？”
而一听武书只想让夜行兽陪同自己前去，碑灵极度不爽道，“就那头怕死的驴子吗？这个时候都不知道它在哪呢？此行如此重要……”
而就在碑灵准备继续力荐自己时，就听烈焰锤器灵烈焰应声道，“此事就这么定了。”

碑灵怒道，“这事我不同意！”
就听烈焰锤器灵烈焰冰冷道，“碑灵，一直以来，难道你不自知？多年来，会让你知道大人一直处在沉睡状态，在我看来便已经超越底线了。碑灵，你的嘴太碎了。”
碑灵的嘴太碎了？烈焰锤器灵烈焰的话，直接是让碑灵无言以对。
而在听到烈焰锤器灵烈焰的话后，武书心道，“眼前这个法阵所通向的地方必定是隐藏着很多秘密的，否则，若非碑灵口风不严，以碑灵在战神殿中的地位，是不可能不能进入的。”
而更加令武书感到意外的是，在烈焰锤器灵烈焰同意夜行兽同行后，夜行兽就这么神奇的来到了战神殿。
在见到夜行兽后，碑灵很不爽的盯着夜行兽道，“切，只是速度比牛快一点的驴子，嚣张个屁。”
夜行兽也是灵性十足的，被碑灵这么贬低，也是愤怒的冲着碑灵嘶叫两声。只是，夜行兽内心是懵逼的，碑灵这货疯了吗？先前是不是发生了什么事情？
content_en:
When the two formation patterns appeared, Wu Shu also noticed subtle changes in the formation patterns, and Wu Shu was very surprised. I never thought that in the thick earth continent a long time ago, there were people who could achieve such strength in formations.
The formation patterns engraved on the bodies of the two major store-holding beasts will actually cause spatial fluctuations after they resonate. When the two formations are used together, they will form a space formation. Wu Shu knows better than anyone how difficult it is to master the space magic circle.
After the formation was formed, an irresistible sense of oppression came towards them. As soon as they felt the pressure, the giant elephant and the giant ape that swallowed the sky voluntarily bowed their heads to the depths of the formation. At this time, a majestic voice was heard, "Boy, you should feel honored to be a member of the Wu clan. Little Elephant, Little Ape, from now on, leave this kid's affairs to me."
When he heard the voice, Qingtian Giant Elephant was in a happy mood, but suddenly it became worse. Could it be that the oppressive feeling I just felt just came from the sleeping adult? Who is the source of this sound? Qingtian Giant Elephant is very familiar with it. It is the weapon spirit flame of the lord's weapon Flame Hammer.
As a weapon spirit, Lieyan has always been pretentious. After all, since he followed that master, none of the peerless weapons forged by that master came from under its hammer. And because the flame hammer has its own spirituality, any weapon that has been tempered by the flame hammer will not only have flame attributes, but will also be more suitable for fusion with spirits of wood and fire attributes.
It is precisely for this reason that the flame hammer weapon spirit Lieyan is like a reborn parent in front of those spiritual creatures and beasts who want to use the power of the weapon spirit to increase their cultivation limit.
Of course, although Lieyan, the flame hammer weapon spirit, does have pride, the tablet spirit does not take it seriously. Even though the sky-holding giant elephant and the sky-devouring giant ape would not question the flame hammer spirit directly, the tablet spirit said in a naughty tone, "Hey? Long time no see, little Lieyan."
Little Lieyan? ? ?
When he heard someone call him that, Lieyan, the weapon spirit of Lieyan Hammer, was slightly angry. And then thinking that it was the old monster Bei Ling who called him that, Artifact Lieyan couldn't help but said, "Bei Ling, long time no see."
The tablet spirit said in a scheming manner, "Why don't you be so reserved when you speak? We are all our own people now, and I have already recognized my master."
Wu Shu came from the Wu family, and the stele spirit came to the War Temple with Wu Shu, and now he openly admitted that he was the owner. This couldn't be clearer. Showing his relationship with Wu Shu means that the stele spirit now has the need to protect Wu Shu Zhouquan.
Before Lieyan, the spirit of the flame hammer, could reply, the tablet spirit said in a deep voice, "The boy you are talking about is my master."
"Oh!"
Even though he heard that the tablet spirit was exerting pressure on him, Lieyan still just responded in such a simple way.
The stele spirit was extremely unhappy to be treated with such contempt. The stele spirit said in a deep voice, "He wakes up? Tell him, if..."
When the stele spirit was about to utter harsh words, Wu Shu, who was seriously injured on the side, couldn't listen at all. The spirit of the stele behaved like this because he wanted to accompany Wu Shu to heal his wounds, but it was also because of Lie Yan's previous disrespect for Wu Shu. In Wu Shu's view, once the injury is healed, there will be plenty of opportunities to ask Lie Yan for advice.
Seeing that Wu Shu was seriously injured, Lie Yan said noncommittally, "Shenbi, you talk too much. If you have anything to say to the adults, I believe you will have plenty of opportunities in the near future."
And what Lieyan, the spirit of the flame hammer, had already made very clear, was that the spirit of the stele would not be allowed to enter the resting place of that adult this time. When the spirit of the stele was about to speak again, Wu Shu stopped him and said, "Little Ling, you stay here to help the giant elephant and the giant ape that hold the sky. On this trip, let the night beast go with me, right?"
When he heard that Wu Shu only wanted the night beast to accompany him, the tablet spirit was extremely unhappy and said, "Is it just that donkey who is afraid of death? ThisDon't you know where it is all the time? This trip is so important..."
And just when the tablet spirit was about to continue to recommend him, Lieyan, the spirit of the flaming hammer, responded, "That's it. "
The stele spirit said angrily, "I don't agree with this! "
Lie Yan, the spirit of the Flame Hammer, said coldly, "Spirit of the Stele, don't you know this all along? For many years, letting you know that adults have been in a state of slumber seems to me to have crossed the line. Stele Spirit, your mouth is too broken. "
Is the stele spirit's mouth too broken? The words of Lieyan, the spirit of the flaming hammer, left the stele spirit speechless.
After hearing the words of Lieyan, the spirit of the flame hammer, Wu Shu thought to himself, "The place leading to the magic circle in front of me must have many secrets hidden. Otherwise, if the stele spirit had not been lax in his words, it would be impossible for the stele spirit to be unable to enter based on his position in the Temple of War. "
What surprised Wu Shu even more was that after the flame hammer weapon spirit Lieyan agreed to go with the night beast, the night beast magically came to the Temple of War.
After seeing the nocturnal beast, the stele spirit stared at the nocturnal beast in displeasure and said, "Tsk, it's just a donkey that's a little faster than an ox, so arrogant. "
The nocturnal beast is also very spiritual. Being belittled by the tablet spirit, he angrily screamed at the tablet spirit twice. However, the night beast is confused in its heart. Is the Stele Spirit crazy? Did something happen before?
